origin: Unchanged original BlastMBLookupTableNew, contiguous filling and megablast scanners. Full table heads, links, PV arrays, dimensions and mask intervals are compared to Rust constructors, then complete scanner batches/restart offsets to Rust kernels. Covers standard defaults, multiple intervals, empty location error, PV cutoff boundaries and signed-positive integer-log inputs. Discontiguous, mapping and database-count-filtering constructors and width-16 scanner branches are outside supported scope.
